summary: Implemented only the RDGO-001 v3.0 section 9 Gate-8 (process containment and live preflight -- the Shell Gate boundary) production-consumption slice frozen by .1R.13.1 (sections 5/11/12/16/25). One production file changed: src/pcae/core/runtime_dispatch_gate8.py (new; git diff --name-only 6a9d650f HEAD -- src/pcae is exactly that one file). run_gate8_process_containment(gate7_result, *, gate5_result, identity, inputs, authority_current_time, repo_root, effect_plan, descriptor_resolver) is the frozen SOLE production owner of the RDGO-001 section 9 Gate-8 process-containment / Shell-Gate consumption boundary for runtime_dispatch. It (1) consumes a registry-provenanced Gate7Result ONLY via runtime_dispatch_gate7.is_gate7_result -- a forged / object.__new__ / field-reconstructed / copied / deepcopy / serialized / bare decision='ALLOW' lookalike and None all return (None, ('gate8_untrusted_gate7_result',)) and create no Gate8Result; (2) TRUSTED PROVENANCE IS NOT ENOUGH -- Gate 8 additionally requires gate7_result.decision == 'ALLOW' by exact string equality; a trusted NEGATIVE Gate7Result(decision='DENY') -- which is what the real Gate-7 coordinator returns under the current runtime posture -- is rejected with (None, ('gate8_gate7_decision_not_allow',)) BEFORE any Shell Gate evaluation, drift re-resolution, or containment establishment (proven by a Shell-Gate call spy that stays uncalled, and by driving the real run_gate7_runtime_enforcement negative branch through the same labelled provenance substitution the .1R.13.2/.1R.13.3 suites use). No code path converts a non-ALLOW Gate7Result into a positive containment result; (3) consumes a registry-provenanced Gate5Result via runtime_dispatch_gate5.is_gate5_result and re-trusts + revalidates its ValidatedAuthorityProjection at Gate 8's own point of use (is_trusted_validated_authority_projection + revalidate_validated_authority_projection, which re-runs validate_approval and re-resolves credential/proof/approval/expiry/consumption state) -> revocation/expiry/consumption drift fail closed as gate8_stale_validated_authority_projection; the revalidate receives the current authority_current_time (asserted); (4) preserves the exact invocation lineage (invocation_id and attempt_id equal across Gate5Result / Gate7Result / identity -> gate8_invocation_binding_mismatch) and recomputes the subject_scope_binding_digest from identity + inputs via the shared runtime_dispatch_permission._expected_subject_scope_binding_digest (mismatch -> gate8_authority_subject_scope_mismatch); (5) re-checks the fourteen construction facts structurally via _validate_construction_inputs (drift -> gate8_request_currentness_drift:<detail>); (6) re-resolves the exact executable through a TRUSTED, coordinator-supplied descriptor_resolver (never a caller shell string; a non-ResolvedExecutable return -> gate8_invalid_descriptor_resolver) and REFUSES any shell metacharacter (; & | < > $ backtick newline * ? ( ) [ ] { } ! backslash quote) in the executable path or any argv element -> gate8_caller_shell_string_rejected; a non-string argv element is likewise rejected; (7) validates and CONTAINS the exact effect/process description as a structured audit record (Gate8Result(containment_established=False, causing_reason_ids=(...))): effect-plan executable != resolved executable -> gate8_effect_plan_binding_mismatch; resolved descriptor_digest/target_config_digest != inputs.adapter_descriptor_binding -> gate8_descriptor_config_drift; resolved runtime_target_id != inputs.runtime_target_id -> gate8_runtime_target_drift; executable not installed / not a regular file -> gate8_executable_not_installed; os.stat + SHA-256 file-hash read != descriptor pin -> gate8_executable_identity_mismatch (a file stat + hash read, NEVER an execution); cwd not the repository root or beneath it (canonical Path.resolve) -> gate8_cwd_outside_repository_scope; blank/non-string env allowlist name -> gate8_environment_not_allowlisted (names only, never the ambient process environment); child_process_policy not in {prohibited, single_child_limit} or unbounded resource/time/supervision refs -> gate8_containment_profile_invalid; network_denied is not True -> gate8_network_not_deniable; credentials_required is not False -> gate8_credentials_required; (8) consumes the MATURE 88P shell_gate.build_shell_gate classifier READ-ONLY for a defensive command-category cross-check of the resolved executable + argv -- it re-implements NO classification logic (no _classify_command / SGP_CATEGORIES in the coordinator); the resolved program is refused BEFORE the call if its basename is pytest/py.test/tox/nox/unittest (the only path that could drive shell_gate's `pcae doctor test-run` lock probe) -> gate8_shell_gate_preflight_side_effect_refused, so build_shell_gate is invoked only on a proven-inert input; a classifier exception -> gate8_shell_gate_internal_error; a hard_block_present / test_run_preflight_required / any of the 18 mutation/network/secret/environment detected flags / a denied or non-allowlisted category or decision -> gate8_shell_gate_category_denied. The Shell Gate no-effect audit is proven with a _call_doctor_test_run spy that fails the test if invoked. On a completed establishment Gate 8 returns exactly one ephemeral, identity-only (eq is 'self is other', hash is id(self)), non-serializable (__reduce__ raises), non-subclassable (__init_subclass__ raises), _seal-guarded, registry-provenanced Gate8Result (is_gate8_result = exact-object membership in the process-local _GATE8_RESULTS set whose only insertion point is run_gate8_process_containment's completed-establishment return path -- never isinstance / fields / equality / object.__new__ / copy / deepcopy / duck-type); containment_established is a bool (validated in __init__); it carries causing_reason_ids / invocation_id / attempt_id / request_id / gate7_result_digest / effect_plan_digest / containment_evidence_digest / live_preflight_digest / shell_gate_decision / shell_gate_category / expires_at / evaluated_at; it is NOT an execution token (RDGO-001 section 0 wall process permission != dispatch completion) and a containment_established=False Gate8Result is a structured audit record, never partial success. is_gate8_result proves PROVENANCE ONLY, never containment_established -- a future Gate 9 MUST additionally check containment_established is True (a dedicated regression guard is in the suite). UNDER THE CURRENT RUNTIME POSTURE GATE 8 IS STRUCTURALLY UNREACHABLE: two independent reasons, either sufficient -- (a) the real Gate-6 -> Gate-7 chain never yields a positive Gate7Result (run_gate5 returns nothing on the deterministic fixture -> no Gate5Result -> no Gate6Decision -> and when driven, run_gate7_runtime_enforcement returns Gate7Result(decision='DENY') under the unchanged posture), and (b) Gate 8's first checks after provenance are is_gate7_result + decision == 'ALLOW'. Every real Gate-8 call fails closed at the gate8_untrusted_gate7_result / gate8_gate7_decision_not_allow hard stop. The positive containment branch (containment_established=True) is marked pragma: no cover -- production-unreachable -- and is exercised only through a clearly-labelled test-boundary provenance substitution against a real inert executable (/bin/echo), manufacturing NO ValidatedAuthorityProjection, approval, runtime capability, or positive Gate7Result; the real runtime posture is unchanged in every test. Gate 8 CONSUMES NOTHING: no approval / HPAC proof / presentation / challenge / nonce / Gate5Result / Gate7Result / Gate-6 decision / authority record / lifecycle record is created, deleted, or mutated; no durable authority-consumption record is written; no runtime_invocation_authority_consumption primitive is called; both re-resolutions (projection revalidation, executable hash read) are reads. It references NO Gate6Decision / is_gate6_decision / run_gate6_permission_broker / run_gate7_runtime_enforcement / resolve_runtime_enforcement_posture symbol at all (the docstring uses hyphenated 'Gate-6 decision' / 'Gate-7 runtime-enforcement evaluation' prose so the .1R.13.2/.1R.13.3 sole-owner greps stay accurate). Idempotent: repeated evaluation over identical trusted inputs and unchanged context returns fresh distinct objects with identical containment_evidence_digest / effect_plan_digest and zero durable consumption record repo-wide. The whole body is wrapped in try/except Exception -> (None, ('gate8_internal_error_fail_closed',)) with no partial output. NO Gate-9 consumption (AST: no runtime_invocation_authority_consumption / runtime_dispatch_gate9 import; no dispatch_attempted; no Gate9Result), NO Gate-10 effect (AST forbidden-import guard: no subprocess / socket / requests / httpx / urllib / asyncio / multiprocessing / ctypes / pty / fcntl / signal / ssl / selectors; no .dispatch( / Popen( / os.system(; no adapter import). shell_gate.py, runtime_dispatch_gate7.py, runtime_dispatch_gate5.py, runtime_dispatch_permission.py, runtime_introspection.py, runtime_enforcement_safety_authorization.py, permission_broker_foundation.py (POL-005), policy.py and all normative contracts (RDGO-001 v3.0, PBRD-001 v2.0, RPAC-001 v1.0, RIHAC-001 v2.0, RIASC-001 v3.0, HPAC-001 v2.0, PBPA-001, POL-005) are byte-unchanged since the phase-entry baseline 6a9d650f (git diff docs/contracts empty).
